bundle.shortDescription: Verses of five Sanskrit works on plant science, with plants, pictures and recitations
bundle.longDescription: Version 1 (original): the 2011 Vrikshayurveda program rebuilt. Search 869 verses of Brihat Samhita, Krishi Parashara, Lokopakaram, Surapala Vrikshayurveda and Upavanavinoda by plant, common name, keyword or verse; hear the recitations; see each plant's classification, names, distribution, synonyms and pictures. Works offline.
